# ai.diy

> ai.diy is an open-source, self-hosted AI workspace for bring-your-own-key (BYOK) chat.

## Canonical site

- https://ai-diy-demo.vercel.app/
- Workspace: https://ai-diy-demo.vercel.app/workspace
- Source code: https://github.com/Cubinghackerz/ai.diy
- Privacy: https://ai-diy-demo.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms: https://ai-diy-demo.vercel.app/terms

## Product summary

Users connect their own cloud or local AI providers and keep chats, files, Canvas artifacts, memory, knowledge-base chunks, usage events, and preview sessions in browser storage. Provider keys are stored in the browser and relayed per request. The Node server does not need LLM credentials.

## Supported providers

OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, xAI, Ollama, Mistral, Hugging Face, Amazon Bedrock, Azure, Vertex, Vercel Gateway, Together, LM Studio, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

## Capabilities

- Streaming AI chat, reasoning controls, files, image and video generation models
- Web search, URL fetch, calculator, browser Python, memory, on-device knowledge search, MCP, skills, and approved subagents
- Canvas previews for HTML, code, images, and generated files
- Client-side import, export, and optional S3, WebDAV, or Google Drive backup
- Node.js, Docker Compose, or Vercel preview deployment

## Important boundaries

ai.diy does not provide model credits or replace an AI provider. Provider costs, quotas, availability, and data policies remain controlled by each provider. A hosted instance operator can observe request traffic in transit; self-host for infrastructure control. The source is MIT licensed.
